{{Kunark Era}}{{Spellpage| | spellname = Conjure Corpse | spellicon = L | description = Summons your target's corpse to you. Consumes a [[Tiny Jade Inlaid Coffin]] when cast. The advantage over the [[Summon Corpse]] spell is that the reagent is lighter weight at 0.1 and stacks to 20, rather than being a 10 weight container requiring a bag slot. Character to be summoned must be in zone and in group.
